messages:
alex (design): Quick round — thinking about a compact view for the latency page. Idea: show p95 line + thin throughput bars behind it instead of full density heatmap. Gives clearer correlation in a single glance.

rachel (product): I like that. Can we keep the heatmap available as a toggle? some customers want the distribution not just p95.

alex (design): Yeah toggle makes sense. Default for the small panel would be p95+throughput. Full page keeps heatmap option.

jin (eng-ml): From runtime side, throughput overlay could be a thin histogram of requests/sec. Implementing as pre-aggregated per-minute buckets is easiest. Any objections to log scaling option for p95?

sam (eng-platform): Log scale is helpful for wide ranges, but it confuses product folk. Maybe expose it under y-axis > scale: [linear | log] and default to linear.

maya (a11y): Accessibility nits: ensure the throughput bars have sufficient contrast and expose aria-labels that describe "throughput: X requests per min" for tooltip on hover. Keyboard focus should move between series (p95, throughput) with a single tab stop and arrows to toggle.

rachel (product): Copy tweak: instead of "Sampling rate" in the control, use "Request sampling" or "Trace sampling"? Which is less ambiguous?

jin (eng-ml): We send two kinds: header-sampled and full-trace. Maybe use "Trace sampling (captured traces per 1k requests)" as helper text.

alex (design): Proposed compact control layout:
```
[ time range ]   [ metric selector: p95 | p50 | p99 ]   [ sampling: Live toggle + rate dropdown ]
```
Also mini legend with small swatches and keyboard hints (press Enter to focus series).

sam (eng-platform): Implementation note: the compact panel should lazy-load heatmap tiles only when expanded to save network. We'll need a placeholder shimmer for that.

ci-bot: ci/build #452 started by jin — tests for latency-compact-view

maya (a11y): Also add aria-live region updates when the time range changes so screen reader users hear "Showing data from 09:00 to 10:00, p95 = 240ms".

rachel (product): UX question: when sampling is on, the p95 should indicate that values are estimated. Add a small inline badge: "estimated" with tooltip explaining sampling bias.

alex (design): Agree. Badge copy: "estimated — sampling applied". Tooltip content: "Values are computed from sampled requests and may under/over-estimate tail latency depending on sampling strategy." Any suggestions for shorter copy?

jin (eng-ml): Maybe "Estimated (sampling)" — shorter.

alex (design): Works.

sam (eng-platform): Final decision items: default compact shows p95 (linear) + throughput bars, heatmap behind toggle, y-axis scale selector tucked in kebab menu, sampling control shows both toggle and rate with helper text, and aria/live for SR users. I'll create an RFC for the backend pre-aggregation and tile lazy-load.

rachel (product): Timeline: design mock by end of week, dev spike next week, a11y review after spike. :thumbsup: \n
alex (design): I'll drop the Figma link when ready: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/latency-compact

maya (a11y): Quick keyboard prototype idea: when series is focused, arrow keys step between time buckets and shift+arrow moves focus between series. We'll test in the a11y pass.

jin (eng-ml): I'll add instrumentation to indicate when sampling is active in the payload so UI can show "estimated" reliably.

rachel (product): Great. Thanks all — syncing this to board now.

alex (design): thanks! :sparkles:
